snippet.title: Horu Kickstarter Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/glassbeaver/horu

After years in the making, HŌRU is now live on Kickstarter!

Inspired by Star Wars: Empire at War, it's got absolutely massive land battles with hundreds of thousands of units, huge space battles, full-on ship boarding battles, an advanced espionage system, commodities market, magic & lasers, and ten other things I forget.

I've spent years making the game, not least its completely custom C++ engine that I built from scratch. It's stuffed to the brim with all manner of tech required to make a game of this scale work.

I've launched the Kickstarter to fund the remaining assets needed for a playable build: more spaceships, more units, more animations, more sounds, more music, and everything in between.

It would mean the galaxy if you backed the game on Kickstarter.

Tell your friends, gamers, and strangers!

Discord: https://discord.gg/HXv2xUF
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297450/Horu/
